migration_022_description: persistent idempotency ledger (B08): one row per verified scope/action/key with a canonical request digest, owner lease and the committed TaskRef

idempotency_schema.name: idempotency_records
idempotency_schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE idempotency_records (
    claim_id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    scope_id         TEXT NOT NULL,
    action           TEXT NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key  TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_digest   TEXT NOT NULL,
    state            TEXT NOT NULL,
    owner_token      TEXT,
    lease_epoch      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    lease_expires_at TEXT,
    task_id          TEXT,
    operation_id     TEXT,
    created_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (scope_id, action, idempotency_key)
)

idempotency_schema.name: idx_idempotency_state_lease
idempotency_schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_idempotency_state_lease
    ON idempotency_records(state, lease_expires_at)

idempotency_schema.name: idx_idempotency_action_key
idempotency_schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_idempotency_action_key
    ON idempotency_records(action, idempotency_key)
